data.title: TJX: Buy Rating Reaffirmed as Operational Missteps Seen as Transitory; $178 Price Target Maintained
data.description:
Goldman Sachs analyst Brooke Roach maintained a Buy rating on TJX Companies yesterday and set a price target of $178.00.

Brooke Roach has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to TJX’s recent operational challenges and the company’s response. Management emphasized that the Marmaxx softness stems from specific buying, planning, and allocation missteps linked to internal personnel changes, rather than any deterioration in systems, macro environment, merchandise access, or the competitive landscape. They have already identified the problem areas, implemented new reporting tools to strengthen oversight, and are seeing improving trends heading into the third quarter and the key holiday period.

Brooke Roach’s rating is based on management’s confidence in its core buying organization, the depth and reliability of off-price merchandise supply, and the ongoing opportunity to capture share from full-price retailers while accelerating store growth. TJX also highlighted a recent example in Europe where similar execution issues were successfully resolved and followed by strong performance, reinforcing the team’s ability to course-correct. With the price target held steady at $178, Roach views the current setback as transitory, supporting a Buy recommendation on the expectation of operational improvement and renewed growth momentum.
